subject: The outpost yard and gatehouse: walled compound seen from above; a gate in the south wall, a loading yard of packed gravel with crates and drums in two stacks (cover), a gatehouse and a guard shed on the left, a watchtower base on the right, a long barracks block across the north with two doors; lanes run left and right of a central parked cargo hauler.

The corridor grid: a plan of ceramic-grey panelled corridors, four rooms around a central junction hall; each room has a door onto the hall and one back door; pipe runs and filing racks as cover inside the rooms, a bare 4 tile central hall with two pillars.

The records vault: a large circular hall with a ring of dark machine banks and cabinets as cover around a bare central floor, four entrances at the compass points, a raised catwalk platform in the north, and two side alcoves.

A crossing of alleys: two alleys crossing in the middle between building roofs (roofs are solid), market stalls and crates along one alley, a dry fountain bay at the crossing, three alley mouths and a locked yard in the corner.

The rooftop terrace: several rooftops of different heights joined by plank bridges (shown as narrow walkable bands), water tanks, stair housings and chimney stacks as cover, an open central gravel roof, a roof edge (void) on two sides.

The plaza: a small square with a stopped clock-tower base on the north side, a dry fountain in the centre as cover, shuttered cafe fronts on three sides with doors, and four streets entering at the corners.

The trench line: two parallel trench systems (dark cut bands with sandbag edges) crossed by two spurs, a no-man's-land of craters between them, a wrecked field gun at the east end as cover; open lanes along the north and south edges.

The crater field: open cracked mud broken by about a dozen craters of different sizes (low cover), two wrecked tank hulls, a line of burnt stumps; no walls; entry from the west, a dry gully along the east.

The crashed hull: the broken ribs of a huge fallen war machine lying diagonally across the map as large solid cover, a ring of open ash ground around it, scattered plates, two lanes passing either end.
The assembly hall: two long parallel conveyor lines (solid, crossable at three bridges), unfinished shells on the lines as cover, a clear walkway down the middle, a loading door at each end.
The scrap yard: a fenced yard of heaps of broken parts (cover), a gantry crane's rails along the edges, a magnet pad in the centre, a gate in the south fence and a hole in the west fence.

The casting hall: a furnace mouth in the north wall, slag channels cutting the floor into three lanes (with plank crossings), pillars in two rows, catwalk supports at the edges, a bare dark iron plate centre.
The nave: a long hall seen from above, a bare central aisle of flagstones, two rows of pillars and pushed-back pews as cover, a chancel step at the north end and a west door; side chapels as alcoves.
The cloister: an arcaded square walkway (pillars along the inner edge) around an open courtyard garden with a covered well as central cover, four doors at the compass points.
The altar apse: a semicircular apse with a raised bare dais, a ring of candle stands as cover, two stairs, a round gold floor pool of light (a lighter painted patch, walkable), and two side vestries.
The hangar bay: an open painted bay floor with gantry feet and empty cradles as cover, a gutted shuttle in the east, a large airlock door in the south and a small door in each corner.
The rear landing pad: an open circular pad with a scorch ring, loose crates and a mast base as cover, a low parapet around the edge (solid), two ramps in the south and a sealed hatch in the north.

The power core chamber: a ring of resonant conduits (solid) around a dim central well (void), catwalk rails and four bridge crossings, two generators in the corners as cover, entrances at north and south.
